section.4: The Book of Ghusl and Tayammum

4.name_native: The Book of Ghusl and Tayammum

hadiths.text: It was narrated that 'Ali, may Allah be please with him, said:"I was a man who emotted a great deal of Madhi. I told a man to ask the Prophet (ﷺ) (about that) and he said: 'Wudu' (is required) for that
